ui.nativeBadge.attention.description: Windows taskbar overlay accessibility description. Count is the exact uncapped aggregate of canonical unread notifications/asks, acknowledgeable session completions, and authorized Bridge unread messages; not just messages. Compact overlay glyph is separately capped. Keep the product name unchanged.

params.count: Exact nonnegative attention count; ICU locale plural/number formatting.

ui.nativeBadge.attentionPending.description: Windows taskbar accessibility description when unread attention and unresolved actionable requests coexist. A read-but-open ask is pending but contributes zero extra unread units. Preserve both facts and exact count; never say requests are resolved merely because they were viewed.

params.count: Exact uncapped attention count; pending adds no numeric unit.

ui.nativeBadge.pending.description: Windows taskbar pending-only nonnumeric marker accessibility description. No unread attention remains, but unresolved actionable requests still exist. Do not imply a count or a notification body. No parameters.
